app/core.py: The catalog is the boundary. validate walks the graph before rendering and rejects bad props, unknown actions, cycles, missing children, unreachable nodes and excessive size/depth. replay defines the four contracts with a synthetic scenario. generate explicitly separates scripted replay from optional paid provider calls. action is a server-side allowlist.
app/adapters/formats.py: a2ui translates Stack/Text/Metric/Button into basic-catalog components and emits the three ordered envelopes. GeneratedView is deliberately removed from the standard catalog surface and returned as a separate host artifact. openui emits root first and forward references afterward; property insertion order matches library component signatures.
app/adapters/events.py: events yields the official AG-UI lifecycle, snapshot, tool-call argument stream, state delta and finish. encode delegates SSE framing to EventEncoder. The browser reducer accepts only the two supported replace paths.
app/harness.py: run records the user request, constructs the render_ui tool proposal, executes the allowlisted validator, saves its observation, and finishes. The single-call budget bounds execution. This is an intentionally small UI tool harness; it does not invoke a shell.
app/mcp_server.py: FastMCP registers the HTML resource and its MIME type. show_dashboard advertises the resource URI in tool metadata. acknowledge_plan is app-visible and calls the same server action allowlist. The module entry point starts the actual stdio server.
app/server.py: Request bounds input. The generation endpoint dispatches representations and harness execution. AG-UI streams encoded events. The MCP proxy creates a real ClientSession over paired memory streams and allows only known methods and tool names. The source viewer serves only allowlisted repository paths.
app/web/catalog.jsx: Zod schemas feed json-render defineCatalog and defineRegistry. JSONUIProvider supplies renderer contexts. StaticSurface fixes application slots. The OpenUI library uses the same primitives, but Stack adds positional children before direction. GeneratedView always uses an iframe and the common CSP wrapper.
app/web/a2ui.jsx: The official MessageProcessor receives the basic catalog and an action callback. The official A2uiSurface is mounted when a surface is created. Each payload message is processed in order. Generated artifacts are mounted outside that A2UI surface.
app/web/transport.mjs: post checks HTTP failures. agui uses a streaming UTF-8 decoder and buffers frames across network chunk boundaries. It reads official event types, applies only expected state patches, raises RUN_ERROR, and rejects a stream missing RUN_FINISHED.
app/web/mcp-host.jsx: The host discovers the UI metadata before reading the resource. It calls the tool through a real MCP client, mounts the HTML in an opaque-origin iframe, validates event.source, completes initialization, and forwards input/results. Only acknowledge_plan is callable from the app frame.
app/web/mcp-view.html: The trusted app resource has an inline script policy and no network access. It initializes with the host over JSON-RPC postMessage, receives tool results, and renders the bounded teaching graph. Generated HTML is placed in another iframe with an empty sandbox. Its button asks the host to call the approved tool.
app/web/sandbox.mjs: The restrictive CSP is prepended before untrusted markup. Together with sandbox="", this blocks scripts, parent access, network requests and form submission in generated regions. It does not verify factual claims in their content.
app/web/main.jsx: App tracks topic, mode, prompt, results, trace and source selection. run dispatches MCP hosting, AG-UI streaming or JSON generation. The surface chooses the official A2UI/OpenUI renderer, fixed static slots or the official json-render surface. The trace and full source viewer keep the contracts inspectable.
tests/test_contracts.py: Tests check all 24 API combinations, mode invariants, rejected graphs and actions, AG-UI event lifecycle and MCP discovery/resource MIME/tool execution. Browser checks separately establish actual library rendering; stdio smoke checks the process transport.
